title: The Legend of Zelda: Link’s Awakening
shortDescription: A compact island adventure that gives its dungeons, side characters, and strange dreamlike premise a remarkable sense of place.
highlights: A tightly connected island makes every new tool feel immediately useful
Surreal details lend the quest an emotional character all its own
keywords: The Legend of Zelda: Link’s Awakening

signals.label: GameAtlas editorial selection
signals.rationale: An essential Game Boy adventure pick for showing how much atmosphere and structure a handheld quest can hold.
